results.name: Crew 314
results.overview: In a small town where everyone knows each other, three patrol officers Valera, Sanych and Lenya work. Their attitude to work cannot be called conscientious. Often, when faced with the criminal world, they have to act outside the box, sometimes even paradoxically and stupidly, violating the law. Each day on duty is a separate dangerous adventure with a series of ridiculous situations, shootings, random murders and, of course, sparkling dialogues. They often create problems for themselves out of the blue, from which they then have to get out.

results.title: Pit Crew
results.overview: Pit Crew is an animated short starring Mickey Mouse, Donald Duck and Goofy, from the House of Mouse episode "Gone Goofy". Our three heroes are the pit crew for Pete's racing team. The only problem is trying to get to the racetrack on time.

results.title: Air Crew
results.overview: Story of the lives of three Soviet pilots who are united by disaster in a small town in the mountains.

results.title: The Wrecking Crew
results.overview: When Count Contini attempts to destroy the world's economy by masterminding the theft of $1 billion in U.S. gold, ICE chief MacDonald summons secret agent Matt Helm to stop him.

results.name: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
results.overview: When he becomes king, Lee Soo hires the Flower Crew matchmaking agency to make a noble woman out of his first love, Gae-Ddong. Ma Hoon, Young-soo and Do Joon try to fulfill their client's request.

results.name: Skeleton Crew
results.overview: This is the story of Hunter and Anthony, a bear couple, and the tumultuous turns their lives take one Halloween. Alongside their friends and family, they face all the extremes life has to offer with a smile, a sigh, and a sugary sweet.

results.title: Whitmer Thomas: Terminal Crew of Dudes
results.original_title: Whitmer Thomas: Terminal Crew of Dudes
results.overview: Comedian, musician, and actor Whitmer Thomas digs into his small-town Alabama upbringing and his ongoing quest to be cool.

results.title: The Night Crew
results.overview: A group of hard up bounty hunters must survive the night in a desert motel against a horde of savage cartel killers. They soon realize that their fugitive, a mysterious Chinese woman, is much more than she lets on.

known_for.title: The Old Man of Hoy
known_for.overview: Commemorative program for the 25th anniversary of the live broadcast of the ascent of the Old Man of Hoy. In July of 1967, 15 million people watched one of the most audacious BBC outside broadcasts ever undertaken - the climbing of the 'Old Man of Hoy'. Chris Bonnington and Tom Patey, took the East Face; Joe Brown and Ian McNaught-Davis, the South Face; Peter Crew and Douglas Haston took the South-East Arête. A further crew of four climbers- Hamish MacInnes, John Cleare, Rusty Baillie and Ian Clough carried cameras and transmitters. 25 years later, BBC gathers the protagonists to recover the footage and to look back on the achievement.

known_for.title: Joe: A Profile of a Mountaineer
known_for.original_title: Joe: A Profile of a Mountaineer
known_for.overview: Portrait of British mountaineer Joe Brown, who demonstrates his climbing technique and discusses his philosophy of climbing. The film was shot in and around Llanberis, where he lived, and on the cliffs of South Stack Lighthouse in Anglesey. Brown is regarded as the outstanding pioneering English rock climber of the 1950s and early 1960s. He established an unprecedented number of classic new routes in Snowdonia and the Peak District that were at the leading edge of the hardest grades. He made the first ascent of Kangchenjunga in 1955 and and other big achievements in the Alps and Himalayas.

known_for.title: Cerro Torre - The Rape of a Mountain
known_for.original_title: Cerro Torre - The Rape of a Mountain
known_for.overview: In 1971, a year after Maestri's ascent to Cerro Torre, filmmaker Leo Dickinson climbed and filmed an attempt on the Compressor Route. Dickinson left only a few pieces of clean protection at his highpoint (the headwall ice towers) and no additional fixed gear. While he and the rest of the team did not reach the summit, his reaction to the bolts on the Compressor Route compelled him to travel to Italy to interview Maestri. The result was this documentary.

known_for.title: Monolith
known_for.overview: A mother and her son plan a surprise visit to Los Angeles to see her husband/his father. Halfway there they get into a terrible accident in the middle of nowhere and now must fight to survive.

results.title: Wrecking Crew
results.overview: Follows a crew as they work under a deadline set by their boss to complete the demolition of a building. Touches on the lives of several of the crew in their lives away from the job and shows rhe comraderie of the crew in their work and even away from work.

known_for.title: 48 Christmas Wishes
known_for.overview: Holiday magic has never gleamed brighter as Santa’s Elves head out on an adventure to bring every boy and girl their Christmas wish while also bringing a family back together in this heartfelt Christmas movie from Gaumont. After accidentally destroying a bag of Christmas wishes from a small town on the eve of Christmas Eve, two junior elves learn that if even one wish goes unfulfilled, Christmas could be extinguished forever. For the first time in their lives, the elves Mindy and Cam venture out of the North Pole and sneak into Minnedoza to collect the lost wishes. Along the way they enlist the help of young Blake, whose family has a difficult time celebrating Christmas since his father died. With their deadline fast approaching, Mindy and Cam have only one more wish to find…but whose could it be? It’s up to Mindy and Cam to find out and save Christmas!

known_for.title: Tilt Mode Army - Man Down
known_for.overview: The TiltMode Army's Man Down video featured Paul Sharpe, Jerry Hsu, Jose Rojo, Louie Barletta, Matt Eversole, Eddie Nemeth, Phil Shao, Tim Brauch, Jason Adams, Colt Cannon, Caswell Berry, Marc Johnson and the rest of the TiltMode homies.

results.name: Cartel Crew
results.overview: A look into the lives of descendants of the Cartel life living in Miami as they navigate adulthood and the effects the legacy has had on their upbringing.

known_for.title: Righteous Villains
known_for.overview: A modern day tale of good vs evil, secret societies, sorcery and Satan.

known_for.title: Villain
known_for.overview: After 10 years, Eddie Franks is out of prison and trying to stay on the straight and narrow, but his drug-mule brother, Sean has other ideas. Rival gangster brothers demand Sean repay his debt to them, causing Eddie to get tangled in the crossfire, and he ends up using his life savings to calling in favours with mobster friends to try and help.

known_for.title: Smoking Guns
known_for.overview: A young gambler makes a large, risky bet on a horse race. When the odds turn in his favour, more than one party has sudden interest in the winning betting slip, and they'll do anything to get their hands on it.

known_for.title: The Power Stone
known_for.overview: In a distant galaxy, something has happened. Something big. And somehow, these kids got involved. What will they do to save the powerstone and ultimately save the world?

results.title: Night Crew
results.overview: One July evening, a vocational school student nicknamed Rooster, a second-year student Balda and the well-read Kid started a fight. And when they saw the police car, the friends fled, stole the car and took two girls with them. However, the night crew's fun will end with tragic consequences.

results.title: The Crew
results.overview: A documentary that investigates the meticulous process of film-making in all the three phases of production, told from the perspectives of Egyptian film-makers, celebrities, and other contributors to the film industry.

results.name: Da Boom Crew
results.overview: Four foster kids create a video game about heroes going up against space alien terrorists. Then a portal appears and pulls them into a dimension which is really similar to their game. They live adventures in this parallel world, as they embark on a quest to find their missing video game cartridges and stop the sadistic extraterrestrial emperor Zorch from taking control of this intergalactic dimension.
